QuestInfo.name: Legor's Second Truth
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2081300##k said she'll tell me the second truth and told me to come talk to her again when I'm ready.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2081300##k told me about the Holychorus, which is the Second Truth. She said she had one final story to tell me.

0.0: The second story is about a growing stone. Do you wanna listen to it?

yes.0: Good. You deserve to listen to the story. Talk to me you're ready.

no.0: Are you afraid? You came this far. Don't be discouraged.

1.0: Have you been to the Aquarium under the sea? It is a mysterious place, floating over the valley of the deep sea. Haven't you wondered how it floats?
1.1: There is a stone called the #bHolychorus#k underneath the valley of the Deep Sea. Nobody knows how it came to be there, but it has been there for ages.
1.2: #bHolychorus#k has a strange power that purifies the sea. That's how Aqua Road is purified and the Aquarium can float over the valley under the sea. If the #bHolychorus#k disappears, the sea will grow dark...

yes.0: This is the end of the second story. Talk to me when you're ready to listen to the third story.
